A jungle-dragon breed — vivid emerald-and-gold banded scales like exotic snake-patterning on a thick Western frame, broad flat curved horns overgrown with orchids, brilliant iridescent throat-fan flaring in display, humid heat-shimmer around its body, a heavily muscled four-legged rainforest predator.

A brine-dragon breed — salt-white and deep-teal encrusted scales caked in crystallized sea-salt, forward-curving narwhal-like single central horn, perpetual saltwater streaming from between scale-gaps, barnacles clustered at its leg-joints, a barrel-chested wave-battered four-legged coastal titan.

A ash-dragon breed — pale powdery grey scales shedding fine ash-dust with every movement, hollow porous horns emitting thin streams of smoke, eye-sockets glowing dim coal-red within an ashen skull-like head, a gaunt but four-legged heavily built body of smoldering long-dead fire.

A deep-sea breed — deep-abyssal-blue scales fringed with bioluminescent teal-and-violet fin-frills along jaw, neck and tail, short swept nacreous horns, four powerful webbed legs, its chest and underbelly pulsing with cold living light in rhythmic slow waves.

A storm-drake breed — slate-blue-grey scales plated like overlapping armored shingles, jagged lightning-fork horns crackling at the tips, four muscular grounded legs, storm-dark wing-membranes veined with caught electrical filaments, ozone stench rolling off its constantly charge-humming heavy body.

A magma-stone breed — rough cooled-basalt black scales with rivers of deep orange-red magma glowing through every crack, squat back-curved horn clusters, a barrel-chested four-legged frame that leaves scorched prints, pools of liquid rock weeping slowly from its knuckles.

A tundra-breed — thick layered ivory-white scales frosted at every edge like packed permafrost, wide curling ram-like horns pale as bleached bone, a massively furred-ruff around the neck, four broad-padded legs built for frozen ground, exhaling blizzard-cold vapor.

A poison-swamp breed — sickly yellow-green iridescent scales slick with toxic secretions, thin curving venomous-tipped horns dripping, a squat four-legged stocky build, bubbling caustic foam at the jaw corners, lurid purple underbelly glowing faintly under overhanging fungal canopy.

A rot/fungal breed — mottled dark-brown and grey scales encrusted with shelf-fungus growths, pale bioluminescent spore-clusters dotting its hide, gnarled twisted mushroom-cap horns, a thickset four-legged body releasing slow drifting clouds of glowing spores with each heavy step.

A iron/forge-dragon breed — dark gunmetal-grey scale-plates riveted in appearance with ridge-lines like hammered iron seams, blunt squared-off industrial-looking horns worn flat, a massively heavy four-legged body radiating furnace-heat, rivulets of white-hot metal occasionally weeping from joint gaps.

A sea-cliff breed — grey-green barnacled scales crusted with shells and salt-crystal deposits, swept-back bleached driftwood-pale horns, a hunched powerful four-legged coastal frame, brine-water dripping constantly from its jaw, kelp draped across its wide salt-weathered spiked back ridge.

A plague/ash breed — dull ashen pale-grey scales flaking like old char, crumbling blunted short horns powdered at the tips, dark hollow eye sockets, a gaunt four-legged frame shedding slow drifting ash-flakes, a miasma of grey particulate hanging perpetually in its wake.

A jade/earth breed — deep malachite-green smooth-polished scales banded with darker emerald veining like natural stone, short broad curved earth-brown horns, a tremendously heavy low four-legged build, chunks of raw soil and root clinging to its legs, smelling of deep wet earth.

A crystalline-gem dragon breed — translucent faceted scales of pale violet-rose refracting rainbow light, sharp geometric horn-clusters of raw amethyst, a chunky four-legged body scattering prismatic shards across the ground, interior glow pulsing with each breath.

A magma-crystal dragon breed — jet-black basalt-textured scales studded with jutting raw ruby-red crystal growths, twin jagged volcanic-glass horns, a chunky four-legged form venting steam from crystal-lined vents along its spine, molten glow seeping between crystal clusters.

A tundra-permafrost dragon breed — pale grey-white scales with a faint blue undertone, thick and densely overlapping like ice-sheets, a pair of broad moose-like antlered horns rimmed with hoarfrost, massive four-legged arctic build, wing-membranes opaque white and frostbitten at the edges.

A midnight-starfield dragon breed — deep blue-black scales flecked with tiny points of cold silver light like embedded stars, twin curved obsidian horns with faint silver veining, a heavy four-legged celestial body, wing-membranes a sweep of nebula-deep violet and midnight blue.

A glacier-blue dragon breed — deep cerulean-blue scales smooth as polished glacial ice, a single great swept-back horn of solid ancient ice, a hulking four-legged polar build, faint cracks of deeper blue running through its scales like crevasses, icy breath crystallizing mid-air.

A meadow-wind dragon breed — soft sage-green and pale gold scales with a feather-light iridescent sheen, slender sweeping curved horns of pale ivory, a four-legged lithe build, wing-membranes almost translucent in sunlight, wildflower seeds and pollen drifting in its wake.

A blood-iron war-dragon breed — deep crimson-red scales edged in tarnished black iron, scarred and battle-notched, a crown of six brutal forward-jutting horns, a massively scarred four-legged warlord build, wing-membranes patched and leathery, dried blood staining the joints of its armor.

A lichen-stone mountain dragon breed — rough grey granite-textured scales mottled with patches of orange and white lichen, a pair of heavy curling ram-like horns of dark stone-grey, an enormous four-legged alpine build, ancient and weathered, blending almost seamlessly into cliff-face rock.
